rule: Background 0. A legend is an orthogonal chain: source colour s, an adjacent different target colour t, then an anchor cell (background or 8) one step further. The diagonally connected 8-shape touching the anchor's 3x3 is the stencil. Erase every legend cell (s, t, 8s) and every cell of a mapped source colour. Then stamp the stencil in colour t at every loose s cell, with the loose cell in the anchor's place and clipping at the border. Unmapped colours stay. Swaps and chains are simultaneous (non-transitive), read from the input.
scope: Infer multiple source-target-stencil legends, erase their footprints and simultaneously stamp input source occurrences with target-coloured stencils. Includes interlocked pinwheel/touch layouts, colour swaps/chains, long loose runs, decoys and border clipping.
constraints: All five canonical pairs reconstruct exactly and1000 distinct independent archived-solver seeds pass.

authored_scope: Random scenes have 1-4 legends with distinct sources; 4 legends are reachable by default when the area is >= 225. Directions are any of the four. Stencil families are lines, bars, chevrons, vees, rings, tees, diamonds, X shapes, diagonals, hooks, wings/rails flanking the target, and random 8-connected blobs. Anchors may be 8 or background. Targets may be other sources, giving swaps and chains. There are three layout styles. Separated legends are at distance >= 2. Interlocked pinwheels have 2-4 arms around a shared background centre with diagonally touching sources, like train pair 2. Interlocked touch layouts have a visible cell 8-adjacent to another legend; exact read-back decides validity. Interlocked layouts are used in about 30% of default scenes with >= 2 legends and can be forced with interlock=True or forbidden with False. Long straight loose runs (length 3 up to the full side) of a mapped colour occur in about 30% of default scenes or can be forced with long_runs=True. They are usually abutted by a partner run (L corner, collinear continuation or T). The partner is a second mapped colour, often the swap partner as in train pair 4; with one legend it is an unmapped colour. Other loose cells are isolated, attached blobs, cells diagonal to legends, decoy s/t pairs, and unmapped distractors. Default sides are 6..24, and explicit sides 5..30 are accepted (above 20 is a synthetic extension). Explicit legends/loose cells reconstruct the fixtures exactly. Deliberately not supported in random mode: stamps of different colours overlapping, stamps over unmapped cells, fully clipped stamps, duplicate source colours, and stencils made of several 8-components. Overlap order by source scan position is implemented only for explicit scenes.
authored_constraints: Every input reads back (exact local legend scan) as exactly the latent legends: no spurious chain with an 8 near its anchor, no merged or foreign 8-components, no reverse reads.
Anchor cells hold only 0 or 8; a loose cell on an anchor is rejected.
Source colours are distinct and never 0 or 8; s != t.
Legend cells, anchors and loose cells never overlap.
Random mode: no cell receives two stamp colours, no stamp covers an unmapped loose cell, and every stamp keeps at least one in-bounds cell.
0 is strictly the most frequent input colour.
Long-run cells stay at Chebyshev distance >= 2 from legend footprints and >= 3 from any 8, so abutting different-colour runs never form legends.
interlock=True guarantees two legends whose visible cells are 8-adjacent; interlock=False keeps footprints at distance >= 2.
height, width, num_legends and all explicit colours and coordinates must be real ints; bool and float are rejected with ValueError.
Every mapped source has at least one loose cell, and legends are always erased, so outputs differ from inputs.
